biomes.name: rift rim S
biomes.notes: The S rim, the black rim (biomes/riftrim/PLAN.md section 3). Split from 'rift rim' 2026-10-23, with the west bend south of the w rift highland.

biomes.name: High Rift
biomes.notes: Propagating eastern tip of the Great Rift between Oidong Valley and Siphon Pits: Opaline Sinter Staircase, North Mirror Graben (Lake Verdigris & Lake Cinnabar), Dorsal Wedge median horst, South Fire-and-Ice Coulee, and The Singing Gjar.

biomes.name: rift rim N
biomes.notes: The N rim, the glass rim (biomes/riftrim/PLAN.md section 3). Split from 'rift rim' 2026-10-23; its west end follows the w rift highland's border.

biomes.name: godshearth
biomes.notes: A caldera cut into the Godthrone's south flank: floor 3.6-3.75 km, walls 3-4 km high, the hot lake (3,642 m) and the spillway south. Climate (the owner, 2026-11-09): cools with height, 6 C per km from a floor of +7 C (warm month 15 C, days 24 / nights +6; cold month -2 C, days +7 / nights -10, to -18 C in the cold-air pools on clear nights): Cwb on the floor, Dwb on the benches, Dwc and ET on the rim. Rain 750-925 mm, about 70% of it in the warm half as afternoon storms, so the nights and the winters are clear (the model holds annual rain only). biomes/godshearth/PLAN.md.

caverns.name: NW Twin Caldera & Caravan Skylight Vault (Nafkh al-Dukhān)

caverns.name: Sacred River Alph Pressurized Subglacial Reservoir
caverns.notes: Subglacial meltwater cavern on Xanadu's NE ice wall where geothermal pressure drives the bursting chasm fountain at the head of the Sacred River Alph (biomes/xanadu/NOTES.md).

caverns.name: Kverkfjoll / Erebus Blue-Ice Fumarole Vaults
caverns.notes: Subglacial ice caves at +5,420 m beneath the +5,880 m SE Twin summit (`erebustwin`, biomes/twins/PLAN.md): blue-lit glacier vaults with 88 C boiling geysers and hollow fumarolic ice chimneys.

caverns.name: Bitta ('Bitter Water') Lava-Tube Spring Mouth
caverns.notes: Distal lava-tube spring surfacing at the fan toe of Oasis #4 (Bitta / al-Bitar, biomes/catch/PLAN.md), discharging mineralized volcanic brackish water.

caverns.name: Lasso ('The Last Water') Sub-Fan Cistern
